title: Seat Comfort
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G60's seats and overall ride comfort positively, with a smaller set comparing seat comfort unfavorably to other BMW models and many fragments too vague to classify.

positive.summary: Positive reviews most often say the seats feel comfortable or very comfortable, and some also praise the car's overall comfort.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the seats are less comfortable than those in other BMW models or that customers want more seat comfort.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention comfort without enough detail to tell whether the experience is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sampled examples are heavily skewed toward short seat-comfort statements, so other comfort aspects may be underrepresented.
Several example fragments are too brief or context-free to determine sentiment reliably.
One sampled positive example appears phrased like a request for improved comfort, which suggests labeling ambiguity in the source data.
